question_text: Was Charleston County's network incident a cyberattack?
answer_text: Yes, by the county's own account: it calls it a "sophisticated cyberattack" identified Nov 16, says data was copied from its systems, and says SLED is treating it as a criminal investigation. Who, how and what data: not established.
label: Confirmed
what_would_settle_it: The county's forensic findings on how the attackers got in, or an independent report.

question_text: Was data taken from Charleston County's systems?
answer_text: Yes, according to the county: it has confirmed data was copied from its systems. What data, and whether it includes personal or financial information, is not established.
label: Confirmed
what_would_settle_it: A county or SLED statement saying what the data was.

question_text: Was my personal or financial information taken?
answer_text: Not established. The county says investigators are still working out what the data was and whether personal or financial information is involved.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A county notice describing the data, notices sent to affected people, or a breach report to the South Carolina Department of Consumer Affairs (required when more than 1,000 South Carolina residents are affected).

question_text: Who attacked Charleston County, and was it ransomware?
answer_text: Not established. Neither the county nor SLED has named an attacker, and we found no report of a ransomware claim or a ransom demand.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: The county, SLED or an independent report naming an actor or confirming a demand.

answer_text: The county says no: day-to-day operations are unaffected and core life safety services remain intact and fully functional. We found no report saying otherwise.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Is this connected to the other outages and disruptions this month?
answer_text: Not established. A Post and Courier report notes the timing but links nothing, and we found no source tying the county incident to any other.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An official or independent finding linking the incidents.
